projectDescription: A modular school management platform for UK schools covering compliance, safeguarding, development planning, staff appraisal, calendars, enrolment, self-evaluation, and more.
keyFeatures: Risk Assessment management with approvals and staff read-confirmations
Health & Safety Audit with 280 checks across 35 categories
Safeguarding Audit aligned to Section 11 of the Children Act 2004
Compliance Audit tracking statutory requirements and website obligations
School Development Planning with themes, initiatives, actions, and progress tracking
Professional Development & Appraisal with objective setting, interim, and final reviews
Professional Standards self-reflection with evidence storage
Ofsted Self-Evaluation Form (SEF) with criteria-level evaluation
SIAMS, Catholic, and Orthodox Self-Evaluation frameworks
School Calendar with iCal publication and weekly staff digests
Online Enrolment with ATF file export for MIS import
Curriculum publication via JSON API for school websites
Room Checks for site health and safety compliance
AI Tools including image generation for staff demonstrations
Multi-school (MAT/LA) group management with centralised controls
Role-based permissions: Administrator, Manager, Owner roles per module
publicApiSurface: Curriculum JSON API — unique URLs per school for website integration
iCal feed URLs for Calendar module (staff, parent, governor views)
ATF file export from Enrolment module for MIS import
Staff Contact Form web widget via Website Utilities module
Word of the Week data feed for school website display
